"""Recorded single-episode controller. Robot service is the only state source."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=Path('/app/output')
r=Robot()
spec=r.spec()
ranges=np.array(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['range_rad'])
def observe():
    o=r.get_obs(video='none');o.save(OUT/'current');return o

def move(q,n=1,label='move'):
    q=np.array(q,float)
    if q.ndim==1:q=np.repeat(q[None],n,axis=0)
    a=np.clip(2*(q-ranges[:,0])/(ranges[:,1]-ranges[:,0])-1,-1,1)
    with (OUT/'actions.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'label':label,'radians':q.tolist(),'actions':a.tolist()})+'\n')
    o=r.submit('joint_position',a,cameras=['room_camera'],video='frames',video_fps=25)
    o.save(OUT/'current');o.save(OUT/('step_%04d'%o.meta['control_steps']))
    p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'])
    print('step',o.meta['control_steps'],'done',o.done,o.meta['reason'])
    print('q',np.round(p[:19],3));print('vel',np.round(p[19:38],3));print('imu',np.round(p[38:],4))
    return o

def ramp(q,n=10,label='ramp'):
    p=np.array(r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none').meta['proprio']['now'])[:19]
    return move(np.linspace(p,q,n+1)[1:],label=label)

if __name__=='__main__':
    # Replay the sequence of servo commands saved during interactive control.
    import argparse
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--replay',action='store_true');args=ap.parse_args()
    if args.replay:
        records=[json.loads(x) for x in (OUT/'actions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
        for rec in records:
            o=r.submit('joint_position',rec['actions'],cameras=['room_camera'],video='none')
            if o.done:break
    else:print(r.status())

import json,numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
S=json.load(open('/app/output/spec.json'))
axes=np.array(S['proprio']['axis']); centers=np.array(S['proprio']['position_m'])
# link index -> actuated joint and parent
links=S['links']; names=links['names']; parents=links['parent']; jnames=S['proprio']['joints']; masses=np.array(links['mass_kg']); coms=np.array(links['com_m'])
jmap={name+'_link':i for i,name in enumerate(jnames)};jmap['torso_link']=10

def fk(q):
 Ts={};points=[]
 for name,parent,c in zip(names,parents,coms):
  T=np.eye(4) if parent is None else Ts[parent].copy()
  if name in jmap:
   j=jmap[name];R=Rotation.from_rotvec(axes[j]/np.linalg.norm(axes[j])*q[j]).as_matrix();A=np.eye(4);A[:3,:3]=R;A[:3,3]=centers[j]-R@centers[j];T=T@A
  Ts[name]=T;points.append(T[:3,:3]@c+T[:3,3])
 points=np.array(points)
 return Ts,points,np.sum(points*masses[:,None],axis=0)/sum(masses)

def report(q):
 T,p,cm=fk(q)

  xyz=np.mean(links['feet'][foot],axis=0);xyz[2]=links['feet'][foot][0][2]
  print(foot,T[foot][:3,:3]@xyz+T[foot][:3,3])
if __name__=='__main__':

 report(q)

def track(path,start,end,scale=5,label='kinematic reach',feedback=True):
    from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none');rows=[]
    for step in range(start,end):
        t=(step+1)/scale;i=min(int(t),len(path)-2);f=t-i
        x=path[i]*(1-f)+path[i+1]*f
        q=x[6:].copy();p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'])
        gd=Rotation.from_rotvec(x[3:6]).as_matrix().T@np.array([0,0,-1.])
        desired_pitch=np.arctan2(gd[0],-gd[2]);actual_pitch=np.arctan2(p[41],-p[43])
        desired_roll=-np.arctan2(gd[1],-gd[2]);actual_roll=-np.arctan2(p[42],-p[43])
        if feedback:
            q[[4,9]]+=np.clip(.55*(actual_pitch-desired_pitch)+.08*p[39],-.3,.3)
            q[[1,6]]+=np.clip(.45*(actual_roll-desired_roll)+.06*p[38],-.15,.15)
        q[[3,8]]-=.10
        a=np.clip(2*(q-ranges[:,0])/(ranges[:,1]-ranges[:,0])-1,-1,1)
        with (OUT/'actions.jsonl').open('a') as file:file.write(json.dumps({'label':label,'radians':[q.tolist()],'actions':[a.tolist()]})+'\n')
        o=r.submit('joint_position',a,cameras=['room_camera'],video='none')
        rows.append(p.tolist())
        if o.done:break
    o.save(OUT/'current');o.save(OUT/('step_%04d'%o.meta['control_steps']));p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now'])
    print('step',o.meta['control_steps'],'done',o.done,o.meta['reason']);print('q',np.round(p[:19],3));print('imu',np.round(p[38:],3));print('desired base',np.round(x[:6],3))
    return o
